title: pretty ROSY|Plus Size Split Ruffles Sleeves with Bowknot Double V-neck Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Embrace your curves and exude elegance with the Plus Size Split Ruffles Sleeves with Bowknot Double V-neck Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress. Designed to flatter and celebrate your figure, the split ruffle sleeves create a romantic and feminine look. Perfect for a glamorous evening affair or a formal wedding reception, this chiffon bridesmaid dress will make you feel confident and beautiful as you stand by the bride's side.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
